effects.log: There is a feast. {npc} eats like someone who has not been at home in years, because {he} has not.
{npc} talks until the lamps burn down. What {he} learned is worth a library.

events.text: {npc} writes too many letters for someone with no family. A steward mentions it, very carefully, as if it were nothing. {npc} smiles at you in the corridor the same way every day, which is the strange part.

effects.log: Two of your people will watch {npc} for a season.
Everyone writes letters. You let it pass.

events.text: Someone has been in your study. Nothing is missing. The brush is on the wrong side of the inkstone, and {npc} was the last one in the corridor.

choices.text: Leave a false letter on the desk, and watch

effects.log: You leave a letter about a plan that does not exist, and set eyes on the corridor.

choices.text: Move the brush back and forget it

effects.log: You move it back. It is probably nothing.

events.text: {npc} kneels in the courtyard with the letter still in {his} sleeve, written to {pth_house}. {He} does not deny it. "I was sent," {he} says, "the way people like you send people like me."

effects.log: {npc} is put out of your gate before dawn.
{npc} looks up for the first time. "And if I say yes?" Then you will see.
You give the order. Your house is very quiet that night.

events.text: Your people bring {npc} in with ink still on {his} fingers and a cipher wheel sewn into {his} collar. The cipher is one {pth_house} uses. {npc} looks at it, and at you, and laughs a little. "Well," {he} says. "Now what?"

effects.log: You let {him} go with nothing. The house that sent {him} will know you know.
From now on the house that sent {him} will read what you want it to read.
It is done before noon. The cipher wheel goes into your own drawer.

events.text: {npc} brings you the letter {he} is about to send to {pth_house}, as {he} does every month now, for you to correct before {he} seals it. Today you change one number. Somewhere, a whole council will plan around it.

effects.log: One number. It will cost them a season.

choices.text: Let it go as it is, for once

effects.log: {npc} raises an eyebrow, and seals it. A true letter now and then keeps the lies believed.
